name: Marketing Cloud RMM email creates Case with correct routing
description: Verifies that emails sent through Marketing Cloud RMM with differently formatted From addresses create Cases correctly. Tests that Initial Request Sent To Addresses shows the formatted @asu.edu address, email body is in Case Description, and auto-response is not triggered (CAR for MC address has no auto-response configured).

sfmcVariants.description: Sandbox address as sender (loop prevention check)

emailProperties.subject: ET Salesforce Platform Team
emailProperties.textBody: This is a Marketing Cloud RMM test email.
emailProperties.htmlBody: This is a Marketing Cloud RMM test email.

preconditions.note: Ensure the 9 test contacts from the MC report exist with valid email addresses. See: https://asu.my.salesforce.com/00O6T0000068wFd
CAR for primary_email must NOT have auto-response configured (prevents loop between PROD MC and sandbox)

queries.filter: Subject = 'ET Salesforce Platform Team' AND CreatedDate >= {{startTime}}

additionalChecks.description: Verify no auto-response was sent (CAR has no template configured)
Verify sender only received one auto-response (if applicable) and reply doesn't retrigger
additionalChecks.note: Reply to the auto-response and verify it doesn't re-send
